preconditions.description: The number of operations n must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= 3 for t in operations)
preconditions.description: Each operation type t must be either 1, 2, or 3.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= len(sequence) for a, x in add_operations)
preconditions.description: For add operations, a must be a valid index within the sequence.

postconditions.description: The output must be the average of the sequence after each operation.
The sequence must always have at least one element after each operation.
The output must be accurate to within a relative or absolute error of 10^-6.
